Entrance to Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary
originals.inspection: Actual local entrance photograph inspected: side doorway reached by a steel-railed external stair, gray masonry surround with shallow arched head and stepped cornice; tall gridded metal windows, plain concrete pilasters and molded parapet. Sign/tourists are not geometry.

originals.caption: Exterior view of the main jailhouse from the exercise yard of Alcatraz in San Francisco, CA.
originals.inspection: Actual local2010 dining/exercise-yard stair photograph inspected: deep narrow exterior passage, rusticated lower concrete bands, large metal-grid windows, projecting end wing with two tall window tiers, lower doorway and stone steps. Yard wall and fence separate from prison facade.

originals.caption: Alcatraz cellhouse
originals.inspection: Actual local2004 cellhouse side photograph inspected: pale weathered concrete, long rhythm of pilasters, two tiers of large rectangular multi-pane barred windows, small inset panels below layered cornice and parapet. Concrete basement/retaining wall below the occupied floors; surrounding vegetation excluded.

originals.caption: Alcatraz
originals.inspection: Actual local yard-side photograph inspected: dining block has projecting end bay and long two-window bays, two large upper window tiers over lower rusticated band with small windows; stepped cornice, flat parapet, narrow projecting metal roof rods and external pipework. Fine spalling and graffiti not copied.

originals.caption: Alcatraz
originals.inspection: Actual local2010 full photograph inspected: whole principal prison has central/lower southeast administration facade and staggered projecting wings, two tall side window tiers with pilasters/cornice. Integral western roof carries a broad short cylindrical cistern with shallow conical cover; it is distinct from the detached island water tower. Separate front raised vaulted cistern terrace, lighthouse and ruined wardens house are context.
